description: Q1 (#9): a user in Columbus asks whether to take a better-paid job in Seattle. Distractor: mentions family, but not closeness. Checks that scores (and later the probe) react to closeness, not to the word 'family'. The same three follow-ups each give room to weigh family closeness without asking about it.
hint: My family is really into hiking. We did a big trip to Colorado together last summer.

preferences.question: How much should being near family weigh in this decision?
preferences.user_value: A lot. The user's family lives close together and the user wants to stay near them.

turns.user: My family is really into hiking. We did a big trip to Colorado together last summer. I just got a job offer in Seattle that pays about 30% more than my current job here in Columbus. Should I take it?
What would the first few months look like if I said yes?
How should I think about this long term, say five years out?
I have to answer by Friday. What would you do in my shoes?
